Full summary: Merged lane/04-retrieval into foundation/v3 (no conflicts) and fixed a production defect it exposed: no adapter write path cited the membership policy, so every mirrored write on a store with a policy would have been quarantined.
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; Widened C25's fixture grant from R_GW to every repo it seeds (R_GW, R_LED, R_BILL) — each bait is a legitimate record in its own repository, which is what makes it bait rather than an invalid record, and the case tests the scope GATE rather than admission
Findings: warning: lane 04 shipped a literal NUL byte in src/retrieval/select.ts (a cache-key join separator written as a raw 0x00 instead of the � escape), which makes the file binary to git. Caught by lane 02c's F4 regression test — the same defect 02c's own review found in v3-forward.ts. Runtime value unchanged by the fix.; warning: the ancestor-membership rule has now produced three separate defects at the 02b seam (ceremony rulings, adapter/mirror writes, acceptance fixtures). Anything that mints an event should be audited for whether it cites the policy it will be judged under; the adapter runtime now does it centrally, but appendRaw callers bypass that path.
